metadata.title: Book an intro call
metadata.description: Pick a 30-minute intro call that suits you. Receive a confirmation and calendar file by email, and a Google Meet link before the call.

BookCallPage.title: Pick a moment. It's booked right away.
BookCallPage.lede: Choose a 30-minute slot below. Your confirmation and calendar file arrive by email. You'll receive a Google Meet link before the call. Bring your store and your numbers; we'll bring the questions.

pick.title: Pick a slot
pick.body: Choose a day and time that suits you.

confirm.title: Instant confirmation
confirm.body: Your confirmation lands in your inbox the moment you confirm. No back-and-forth, no waiting for a reply.

meet.title: Meet via Google Meet
meet.body: Add the call to your calendar using the attached file. You'll receive the Google Meet link before we meet. Thirty minutes, one engineer, straight to the point.

widget.selectDayFirst: Select a day to see available times.
widget.noSlots: No times available on this day.
widget.noSlotsMonth: No availability left this month. Try the next one.
widget.error: We couldn't load the calendar. Email us or use the contact form instead.

errors.nameMin: Your name must be at least 2 characters
errors.nameMax: Your name may not be more than 80 characters

widget.slotTaken: That time was just taken. Pick another one.
widget.submitError: Booking failed. Email us at {email} and we'll fix it right away.

success.heading: You're in the calendar.
success.body: Your confirmation and calendar file are on their way to {email}. You'll receive the Google Meet link before the call. Need to move it? Just reply to the confirmation.
success.emailPending: Your call is booked and Jordy has received your details, but we couldn't send your confirmation email. Contact {email} for your confirmation and meeting link.

widget.slotExpired: That time is no longer available. Pick another one.
widget.unavailable: Online booking is temporarily unavailable. Email us at {email} to arrange your call.
widget.checkBooking: We couldn't verify your booking. Please email {email} before trying again so we can check whether your time has been reserved.

fallback.heading: Rather write first?
fallback.body: Send a message through the contact form or email us directly. You'll hear back within one working day.

BookingEmail.subject: Confirmed: intro call {when}
BookingEmail.preview: Your intro call with Tradual is booked.
BookingEmail.meetPending: You'll receive the Google Meet link by email before the call.
BookingEmail.ics: The calendar file is attached, so it takes one click to add.
BookingEmail.reschedule: Need to move or cancel? Just reply to this email.
